channel.title: Escape to the Country
channel.desc: A couple from the Surrey town of Epsom enjoy the spectacular landscape in Argyll and Bute, as Nicki Chapman provides them with some expert property advice. For their budget of ?600,000 they want a house with views that just keep on giving. Nicki also takes to the water on Loch Lomond to meet a family who have owned and lived on an island for 70 years.
